mentions.name: Real-Time Communication System
mentions.description: A real-time communication system whose frontend client implements WhatsApp-style messaging features, including chat rosters, read receipts, audio/video calls, and voice messages. The project is currently focused on the client-side UI/UX.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on a Real-Time Communication system, and right now I'm focusing on the frontend side of it.
